propositions: A complexity analyzer uses the lizard library (imported via guard_import with the metrics extra) to compute true per-function cyclomatic complexity across many languages.
The analyzer runs lizard over the scan root and produces per-file and aggregate CCN, populating AnalyzerResult.complexity.
When the metrics extra is not installed, guard_import raises OptionalDependencyError which is caught and converted to Unavailable(reason, accruing_since).
The analyzer is exercised on both Python and a non-Python (JavaScript) fixture to prove cross-language parsing.
Straight-line functions report CCN 1 while branching functions report higher CCN as a negative control.
